title: Can Out-of-Distribution Evaluations Uncover Reliance on Shortcuts? A Case Study in Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's over-reliance on dataset artifacts (e.g., shared words, question-words distance, keywords match, answer length, and entity match) by splitting the in-distribution validation dataset into segments where a shortcut is applicable versus not applicable, and measuring the relative drop in exact-match accuracy.
